text: I can explain a container as a process with namespaces and cgroups, and say when I would insist on a VM or micro-VM instead.
I can diagnose exit code 137 as an OOM kill and CPU-limit tail latency as CFS throttling, and name the fix for each.
I can describe how layers, copy-on-write and digests work, and why a file deleted in a later layer still ships.
I can reorder a Dockerfile for cache hits, turn it into a multi-stage build and calculate the pull cost of a scale-out.
I can write a Dockerfile whose process receives SIGTERM, runs as non-root and takes its configuration at run time.
